description: Optional override of the gates that may run at once on this machine, across all worktrees (D-064 (b)); each holds one slot lock file for its whole run. 0 means derived: max(1, floor(vCPUs x gate.slots_per_vcpu)) (GX-03, D-070). GATE_SLOTS, when set, is an explicit override for one run. Rollback of the sizing: set 3.
